card.name: Dashed divider lines in tables and formulas
card.fires_on: Runs of hyphens that draw a horizontal line, such as a fraction bar in a formula or a section or table divider. Also fires on a lone asterisk right after a table header word.

modes.label: Fraction bars
modes.description: Dashes forming the line between numerator and denominator in a dosing or clearance formula.

modes.label: Section and table dividers
modes.description: Dashes that separate a heading or table row from the text around it.
modes.example: Shake gently before administering the recommended dosage. ------------<<--->> DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION

modes.label: Asterisk after header
modes.description: A single asterisk or asterisk run following a column header or drug class in a table.

card.plain: It marks the ruled lines and asterisks used to lay out tables, formulas and section breaks in label text.
